scope: First-principles diagnostic; no formal qualification or change to existing gates
public_timing: One unprofiled first operation outside rate interval, then 250ms completed-work interval; original alternating data and 64-operation deadline checks; warm all N pages; validation/destruction excluded
native: Copy of unchanged native handoff fixture; add exclusive begin/acquire/payload/page-other/seal/commit cuts and provider byte counters; compare instrumented total against cuts-disabled total
order: Sequential processes; rotate public cases and alternate current/M5 or Fresh/handoff order by block; no concurrent builds/benchmarks
stopping: Fixed counts; correctness, exit, timeout or identity failure stops dependent work and is retained; no extension or trimming
statistics: Descriptive medians and ranges only; no confidence-based pass decision; first/steady/provider counters do not measure DRAM traffic or resident metadata
limits: K/N/B/height controls change workload explicitly. Prebound copy is a byte-matched pixel lower control, not a same-semantics manager and not pure-M subtraction. Recorder phases are nested inclusive: never sum parent and child. x86_64 is Rosetta on this same Mac, not independent x86 hardware. Tails, background drain, upstream and real stroke remain unmeasured.
